issue.title: test_snapshot_includes_live_config_token_refresh_threads flakes under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
Reported by epic phase `sase-sp.6` as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP during the sase-sp landing.
The phase ran a full `just test` on its combined tree (36779 passed, 13 skipped) under
heavy host contention — 27m48s wall clock with many concurrent SASE agent workspaces
live on this machine — and exactly this node failed. An immediate isolated rerun on the
same tree passed.

The subsystem is unrelated to that phase's diff: the phase touched finalizer deferral
adjudication, telemetry, and docs, while this node asserts that the global-state leak
detector's snapshot includes live-config token-refresh threads. That is thread-count
state, which is order- and timing-sensitive under pytest's parallel `-n` lane.

Confirmed still passing in isolation on master at ad9ed74af during the sase-sp landing
turn (1 passed in 2.26s), so the failure is intermittent rather than a standing break.
Serial reproduction has not been attempted; a single full-lane observation is all the
evidence there is.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in a full just test run (36779 passed, 13 skipped, 27m48s wall clock under heavy multi-agent host contention) during sase-sp.6 verification on 2026-08-24. Passed immediately in isolation on the same tree, and again in isolation on master at ad9ed74af. Fail rate 1/3 observations; not reproduced serially.
